title: CD sales growth outpaced vinyl in the first half of 2026
summary: CD sales have demonstrated stronger growth compared to vinyl records during the first half of 2026, marking a notable shift in physical media consumption trends. The article from Consequence highlights how the CD revival, once considered a niche phenomenon, is becoming increasingly difficult to ignore as consumers gravitate toward the format.
problem_solved: Documents the unexpected resurgence of CD sales and its implications for the music industry amid the dominance of streaming platforms.
why_valuable: Provides insight into changing consumer preferences and the cyclical nature of physical media adoption in the digital age.
